interpretation.scope: validation-only; no final campaign or official-test inference

rendering.scope: six descriptive median four-fit sample SDs only; complete/all100 counts; no retention or score axis

seed11_metadata_delta.interpretation: Label and data-digest matches do not prove generator/compiler/evaluator equivalence. Different binary hashes do not prove different algorithms.

statistics.group_retention_summary: median over complete lineages of each lineage median of its four complete fit medians
statistics.group_spread_summary: median over complete lineages of the four-fit sample SD
statistics.incomplete_group: null, no zero imputation or lineage removal
statistics.per_fit_median: median of three informative finite producer-reported retentions with finite null/TRTR/TSTR losses
